svg.title: The first B packer transposes a macro-panel
svg.desc: A four-row, three-K-position example. Input is row-major: each row's K values are adjacent. Packed B is K-major: all four row values for one K position are adjacent. The highlighted value at row 2, K 1 appears in the corresponding packed row and column.
svg.text: adjacent K values within each row
all rows for one K are contiguous
